title: Loan notices were missing from every file in a 123-file test

beats.text: Auditors asked for the borrower notices in 123 federal loan files.

visual.sub: Auditors could not verify the borrower notices

beats.text: None of the 123 files had a notice available for the test.
The auditors also needed monthly records matching federal cash draws to loan disbursements.

visual.kicker: Monthly cash documents were also missing

beats.text: They could not obtain the statements for July 2018 through June 2019.
The federal department closed the FY2019 findings. The next notice test found no exceptions.

visual.kicker: The two controls had different outcomes

beats.text: Monthly cash records were missing again, for August 2019 through January 2020.
The institute said its monthly process normally balanced.

visual.kicker: The two controls had different outcomes

beats.text: The following summary ends at finding 2020-008.
The detailed follow-up also stops there. A separate decision for 2020-009 remains unverified.
